miniProject.title: Mechanisms laboratory: kernel, process, memory, file and container
miniProject.brief: Build the repository-wide mechanisms laboratory that later sections reuse: small kernel, locality, process, memory, file and container experiments with correctness checks and retained raw output. Each experiment pairs a measurement with its environment so later claims stay reproducible.
steps: Create the repository with `lab/`, `kv/` and `dossier/` directories, where each experiment is one `make check` target that writes raw output beside its environment record of CPUs, kernel, compiler and interpreter versions and pinning.

Build scalar, vectorized, dependency and branch variants of one reduction kernel, verify each sum against a Python oracle, and compare enabled and disabled vectorization in saved `objdump` output with pinned repeated timings.

Extend the row-first and column-first traversals into working-set and stride sweeps, read the cache sizes from sysfs and predict where the knees fall, then check each sweep against a Python oracle and keep pinned repeated timings with a topology note.

Write `lab/supervise.py` to run a pipe worker from a descriptor ownership diagram, keep a leaked-writer regression that fails before the fix, and show `SIGTERM` termination with zombie observation and reaping and closure on every exit path under `strace`.

Trace first-touch faults and copy-on-write isolation, stage allocate, free, reuse and free-all cycles with snapshots of requested payload beside resident and virtual sizes, add one sparse mapping, and diagnose retained capacity apart from growth.

Turn atomic publication into `lab/publish.py` with ordered write, file sync, rename and directory sync checked in `strace`, failure tests that leave the old file intact, and a cached read comparison labeled as page-cache reads.

Retain one inspected Docker container OOM with namespace, credential and mount diagrams, configured limits compared with effective limits, PID 1 duties and an orchestrator checklist, and add the Nand2Tetris gate and assembler suites as the logic oracle.
deliverables: The `lab/` directory with one checked experiment per target, raw outputs, environment records and a passing `make check`.
Kernel, locality and I/O tables with pinned repeats, saved assembly, cache sizes and filesystem notes.
`lab/supervise.py` and `lab/publish.py` with diagrams, regression tests and the memory and container reports.

rubric.pass: Every experiment prints a check asserted by `make check`, and each table was verified against its Python oracle.
rubric.strong: Each timing names its oracle and pinning, and the write-up explains assembly and cache evidence plus untested effects.

rubric.pass: The leaked-writer test fails before the fix and passes after, and signal handling reaps on every path shown in `strace`.
rubric.strong: The diagram predicts the observed closes, and an injected parent failure still leaves no zombie and no open pipe.

rubric.pass: Staged snapshots separate retention from growth, publication failures keep the old file, and limits match effective values.
rubric.strong: The diagnosis names the reusable capacity, the sparse case separates virtual from resident size, and the checklist ties each action to its trigger.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone mechanisms laboratory: every experiment here recurs there. The supervisor starts the service in fault tests, and `publish_atomic` publishes the store manifest.
